evidence.finding: Workflow runner persists step intents/results and can resume with compensation checks. Direct steps are explicitly rejected before execution. Dependency execution supports only ensure_running/review/land control steps; other paths run sequentially. Artifacts and injected files pass results between stages.

evidence.title: Tutti src/cli/issue_claim.rs
evidence.finding: GitHub comment-backed leases use TTL/heartbeat, server comment ordering and a winner check to reduce duplicate automation claims; external users can still edit issues and comments. This is not a native issue database.

evidence.title: Tutti src/cli/serve.rs
evidence.finding: HTTP/SSE serves dashboard and status, runs, logs, handoffs, policy records plus up/down/send/run/verify/review/land actions. Localhost is default; non-local binding without bearer authentication is refused. There is no per-user role identity in the route layer.

evidence.title: Tutti src/scheduler/mod.rs
evidence.finding: Five-field cron schedules run on the serving host, persist last runs and prevent the same in-flight key within this scheduler. The server must remain running; there is no vendor scheduler.

evidence.title: Tutti src/webhook.rs
evidence.finding: Config matches source/events and expands incoming JSON into prompts; expansion is verbatim untrusted input. A local JSONL record logs event/outcome.

evidence.title: Tutti src/worktree/mod.rs
evidence.finding: Creates per-agent Git branches/worktrees and can reset a fresh worktree to project HEAD; no OS/container/VM/network isolation is implemented here.

evidence.title: Tutti src/state/mod.rs
evidence.finding: Local JSON/JSONL state stores agents, health, run ledgers, step intents, checkpoints, events and policy records. Run telemetry is a local append-only JSONL file with no uploader. Active events rotate after 5000 entries, retain2500 and archive older entries without a timed deletion promise.

evidence.title: Tutti src/budget/mod.rs
evidence.finding: Weekly workspace/agent token guards apply only when the selected profile plan is API. Warn mode continues; enforce blocks subsequent checked operations. This is not universal in-flight billing enforcement.

evidence.title: Tutti src/usage/mod.rs
evidence.locator: TokenUsage; AggregatedUsage; Claude and Codex parsers
evidence.finding: Reads local Claude/Codex token logs, model and session categories. This does not reconcile actual provider charges or all runtime usage.

evidence.title: Tutti src/permissions/mod.rs
evidence.finding: Configured command allow rules gate workflow commands; absent policy allows. Claude settings receive translated permissions. Different CLI adapters can retain native defaults rather than equal enforcement.

evidence.title: Tutti src/agent/policy.rs
evidence.finding: API-direct library policy filters tools and best-effort network commands; source explicitly says network filter is not a security boundary and requires_approval is reserved, not implemented. This library is not wired to runnable direct workflow steps.

evidence.title: Tutti src/cli/handoff.rs
evidence.finding: Writes handoff packets from current state and terminal context; Apply sends packet text to an existing agent. It does not migrate process memory or transfer authenticated human ownership.

evidence.title: Tutti src/cli/review.rs
evidence.finding: Builds a dated Markdown packet containing branch, merge base, committed/WIP diffs, then prompts a named reviewer. Packet creation alone is not approval bound to candidate HEAD.

evidence.title: Tutti src/cli/land.rs
evidence.finding: Land commits WIP and either pushes/opens a PR or cherry-picks into current branch. Optional TT_ENFORCE_MERGE_GATE checks GitHub required checks and unresolved review threads; it is off without the flag. No separate human approval or exact-HEAD receipt is created.

evidence.title: Tutti src/cli/remote.rs
evidence.finding: Creates an SSH local-port-forward and records named remote hosts; it assumes an already configured remote host/server rather than provisioning managed compute.

evidence.title: Tutti dashboard/style.css
evidence.finding: Browser focus/sidebar/pipeline/ops layouts rearrange at mobile widths. This is source support, not measured usability.

evidence.title: Tutti crates.io version metadata
evidence.finding: Published crates.io maximum is0.9.0, created2026-03-23. GitHub source/changelog and release page expose0.10.1. Cargo install and pinned source therefore differ.

evidence.title: Tutti dashboard/app.js
evidence.locator: agent card keydown298–308; focus Escape868–870; diff984–1002; prompt keydown1042–1045
evidence.finding: Agent cards have button role, tab index and Enter/Space handlers; Escape leaves focus mode. Focus view renders the first100escaped diff lines with addition/deletion/hunk styles and a truncation count. These controls are inspectable; usability was not tested.
